name: Hashiba-senpai
source: Hashiba is a senior in Miho's school and the class heartthrob, and he has a tendency to use women as objects. [Spoiler]As the game progresses, Miho, Kei and Hashiba get involved in a love triangle, and Kei becomes jealous of Miho.[Spoiler]
